_status: Phase 1 executed. Phase 2 drafts (case studies, How I Operate, wireframe placeholders) await the owner's fact-check. Phase 3 journal essays are not written yet.

theme.reasoning: A senior product manager should read as engineering-adjacent and precise: Geist Sans, neutral surfaces, one cobalt accent reserved for interaction. This replaces the Instrument Serif + vermillion editorial-template look.

display.usage: H1, H2, H3, hero statement. Tracking -0.025em, uniform colour.

mono.usage: Metrics, dates, tags, code. Never for headings or body.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold leading-[1.05] tracking-[-0.025em]
scale.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold leading-[1.1] tracking-[-0.025em]
scale.h3: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.15] tracking-[-0.02em]

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetrical 12-column grid. Hairline rules carry structure; no decorative numbering.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (py-24, py-32). Dense internal component spacing.
layout_and_spacing.radius: Sharp edges. rounded-none or at most 2px.

navigation.style: Fixed header. One chrome element may use a subtle blur after scroll; opaque is preferred. Links in Geist Sans, active link cobalt.
navigation.behavior: Sticky z-50. Mobile: hamburger plus a working menu panel.

hero.structure: Name as H1, grounded one-line positioning, then a short proof paragraph. Metrics are a static mono table in SSR HTML.
hero.enhancements: None. No grain, grid lines, accent words, or count-ups.

case_studies_grid.style: Featured card splits text and a diagram slot; standard cards put a diagram slot above the text. Neutral wireframe placeholders until sanitized assets arrive.
case_studies_grid.data_points: AI LMS, Transfez, HM Sampoerna, AI Sales Forecasting, AI Talent Matching, DANA, Apiary.

experience_timeline.style: List view, border-b between items. Period in mono, role in Geist Sans semibold.
experience_timeline.data_points: Doitpay, Zero One Group, Transfez, Learnext, Asa Ren, MCF.

how_i_operate.style: Three stances in a hairline 3-column grid: spec writing, technical due diligence, compliance validation. Each has a concrete example.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling; disable when reduced motion is requested.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: At most one subtle reveal per view. No count-ups, marquees, or fade-up-everything.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Links and cards use the cobalt accent on hover; focus ring uses the accent token.

media.visual_policy: Neutral wireframe diagram placeholders now. Replace with sanitized screenshots, C4 diagrams, flows, or state machines when available. No abstract stock imagery.

icons.style: Sparse, inline, text-sized. No emoji, no sparkle-means-AI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow docs/dhema-me-unslop-guide.md section 2 and .claude/skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md before any UI change.
Geist Sans only. No serif, no Instrument Serif, no word-level italics or accent colours in headings.
Cobalt only on interactive elements. Neutral text and surfaces everywhere else.
No marquees, count-ups, decorative numbering, faux metadata, grain, dot matrices, or decorative grid lines.
Hero metrics render real values in static SSR HTML.
Phase 2 drafts in caseStudies.ts and operating.ts are drafts. Do not add metrics or proof without the owner's confirmation.
Replace wireframe placeholders with sanitized assets; keep the layout slot stable.
Phase 3 journal essays need the owner's material before writing.
